words.example: One person entered a dissent against closing the side counter.
words.exampleZh: 有一人对关闭侧边柜台提出了异议。

words.example: Two members will abstain if the question touches their own team.
words.exampleZh: 如果议题涉及自己的团队，有两位成员会弃权。

words.example: We vote on the holiday roster once that short discussion ends.
words.exampleZh: 那段简短讨论一结束，我们就表决假期排班。

words.example: Collect every ballot and mix them before anyone starts counting.
words.exampleZh: 开始计票之前，请把每一张无记名票收齐并混在一起。

words.example: A quick show of hands is enough for this ordinary roster item.
words.exampleZh: 这个普通的排班事项，快速举手表决就够了。

words.example: The license server was unreachable, and the reading room viewers all dropped into grace mode.
words.exampleZh: 授权服务器连不上，读片室的阅片程序全部进了宽限模式。

words.example: The license key for the dictation software was issued to the old reading room.
words.exampleZh: 听写软件的授权密钥是签发给旧读片室的。

words.example: The trial license on the new viewer expires Friday, before purchasing finishes.
words.exampleZh: 新阅片程序的试用授权周五到期，采购还没走完。

words.example: The perpetual license for the old viewer stays valid even after we stop upgrades.
words.exampleZh: 就算我们停止升级，旧阅片程序的永久授权也仍然有效。

words.example: The subscription license for dictation renews in March, or the microphones stop.
words.exampleZh: 听写的订阅授权三月要续，否则麦克风会停。
